avatarCid.description: CID of the avatar blob uploaded via com.atproto.repo.uploadBlob.

links.description: Links the reader shows on their profile. A Bookshop.org link renders as their store: the host decides, not a separate field.

privateShelving.description: When true, a book the reader shelves without choosing otherwise is kept in their reading space instead of their public repo.

publishAnnotations.description: When true, new and edited notes are mirrored to the reader's repo as readingProgress annotation records.

shareWeeklyReport.description: When true, each weekly report and its card are published at /weekly/<did>/<start>; absent means private.

skinTone.description: Preferred emoji skin-tone modifier for reactions this account writes. Absent means none. It travels with the profile so the choice reaches every device; records hold the toned emoji, while counts group on the base emoji.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone used to bucket reading days. Absent means UTC.

weekStartsOn.description: First day of the reader's week: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Absent means 1 (Monday).

description: User profile record stored on the user's PDS at rkey 'self'.
